title: EventTransformationDef
description:
An event transformation definition from JSON type `"event_transformation"`.

Defines a transformation pipeline for game events, filtering and reshaping event data for use in statistics and achievements.

drop_fields.description: Fields to drop from the event data.

event_transformation.description: ID of another event transformation to chain from.

event_type.description: The event type to filter (e.g. "character_kills_monster", "character_wakes_up"). If not present, this transformation chains from another event_transformation.

new_fields.description: New fields to add to the event data.

value_constraints.description: Constraints on field values to filter events.
